name: What are the pros and cons of living in a waterfront property versus an inland property in Fort Lauderdale?

mainEntity.name: What are the pros and cons of living in a waterfront property versus an inland property in Fort Lauderdale?

acceptedAnswer.text: Waterfront properties in Fort Lauderdale offer direct access to the ocean or canals, often with private docks and desirable views, but typically come with higher purchase prices, increased insurance costs, and specific maintenance requirements. Inland properties generally offer more space for the price, lower insurance premiums, and proximity to different types of amenities like parks or specific school districts. When making this decision, consider your budget, lifestyle, and how much you value water access versus other factors. A local agent can help compare specific costs and benefits for various locations within Broward County.
acceptedAnswer.description: Waterfront properties offer views and water access but cost more in price and insurance. Inland properties often provide more space and lower costs.
